parameters.help_en:
The ID of the watermark template.

You can get the template ID from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848096.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
水印模板ID。
可查看https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848096.html接口返回参数值获取TemplateId
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the watermark template
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The reference width of the video background, in pixels
parameters.name: ref_width

parameters.help_en: The reference height of the video background, in pixels
parameters.name: ref_height

parameters.help_en:
The X-axis offset of the watermark, in pixels.

Relative to RefWidth. If OffsetCorner is TopLeft, XOffset is the horizontal distance between the top‑left corner of the watermark and the top‑left corner of the background video. Positive X points to the right
parameters.help_zh:
⽔印X轴偏移，单位：px。
相对于参考背景宽RefWidth， 如果选择的是TopLeft，那么XOffset是指⽔印图⽚的左上⻆和背景视频的左上⻆的相对位置X。其中坐标指向背景视频中⼼的⽅向为正⽅向，即X轴的正⽅向是向右
parameters.name: x_offset

parameters.help_en:
The Y-axis offset of the watermark, in pixels.

Relative to RefHeight. If OffsetCorner is TopLeft, YOffset is the vertical distance between the top‑left corner of the watermark and the top‑left corner of the background video. Positive Y points downward
parameters.help_zh:
⽔印Y轴偏移，单位：px。
相对于参考背景⾼RefHeight，如果选择的是TopLeft，那么YOffset是指⽔印图⽚的左上⻆和背景视频的左上⻆的相对位置Y。其中坐标指向背景视频中⼼的⽅向为正⽅向，即Y轴的正⽅向是向下
parameters.name: y_offset

parameters.help_en: The height of the watermark image, in pixels. This value is relative to `RefHeight` and will be scaled proportionally with the actual video resolution
parameters.help_zh: 水印图片高度，单位：px。对比参考背景RefHeight，最终按照⽐例进⾏⾃适应缩放为准
parameters.name: height

parameters.help_en: The opacity of the watermark. Value range: `0` (fully transparent) to `255` (fully opaque)
parameters.help_zh: 水印透明度，数值越小越透明。取值：0~255
parameters.name: transparency

parameters.help_en:
The anchor point for the watermark's position. Valid values:

TopLeft

TopRight

BottomLeft

BottomRight
parameters.help_zh:
位置。取值：

TopLeft：左上。

TopRight：右上。

BottomLeft：左下。

BottomRight：右下
parameters.name: offset_corner

parameters.help_en: The URL of the watermark image
parameters.name: picture_url
